passages.text:
The taxi idles outside Velvet. Your phone holds an unsigned invitation. A black envelope lies beside you on the seat. Beyond the window, a narrow awning shelters the side entrance.

You can see black envelope, back seat, taxi window, taxi meter, cab receipt, ceiling light.

Exits: outside.
You take black envelope.

Rain writes over the taxi's tyre marks. Velvet's side entrance glows beneath a narrow awning. The loading bay runs behind the building; a soup kiosk stays lit across the road.

You can see side door, narrow awning, club window, velvet sign, street bin, brick wall.

Exits: inside · loading bay · kiosk · home · front door.

Warm air. Wet wool. A corridor the colour of dried wine. A notice points left to the working toilets. The bar is ahead; a cloakroom opens on the right.

Here: Inez Vale.

You can see dry ledge, wooden bench, toilet notice, portable heater, entry book, paper bag.

Exits: bar · outside · cloakroom · washroom.
You wait 11 minutes. The city keeps its own appointments.
You leave black envelope here.

passages.text:
The taxi idles outside Velvet. Your phone holds an unsigned invitation. A black envelope lies beside you on the seat. Beyond the window, a narrow awning shelters the side entrance.

You can see black envelope, back seat, taxi window, taxi meter, cab receipt, ceiling light.

Exits: outside.
You take black envelope.

Rain writes over the taxi's tyre marks. Velvet's side entrance glows beneath a narrow awning. The loading bay runs behind the building; a soup kiosk stays lit across the road.

You can see side door, narrow awning, club window, velvet sign, street bin, brick wall.

Exits: inside · loading bay · kiosk · home · front door.

Warm air. Wet wool. A corridor the colour of dried wine. A notice points left to the working toilets. The bar is ahead; a cloakroom opens on the right.

Here: Inez Vale.

You can see dry ledge, wooden bench, toilet notice, portable heater, entry book, paper bag.

Exits: bar · outside · cloakroom · washroom.
You wait 11 minutes. The city keeps its own appointments.
You put black envelope on dry ledge.

passages.text:
The taxi idles outside Velvet. Your phone holds an unsigned invitation. A black envelope lies beside you on the seat. Beyond the window, a narrow awning shelters the side entrance.

You can see black envelope, back seat, taxi window, taxi meter, cab receipt, ceiling light.

Exits: outside.
You take black envelope.

Rain writes over the taxi's tyre marks. Velvet's side entrance glows beneath a narrow awning. The loading bay runs behind the building; a soup kiosk stays lit across the road.

You can see side door, narrow awning, club window, velvet sign, street bin, brick wall.

Exits: inside · loading bay · kiosk · home · front door.

Warm air. Wet wool. A corridor the colour of dried wine. A notice points left to the working toilets. The bar is ahead; a cloakroom opens on the right.

Here: Inez Vale.

You can see dry ledge, wooden bench, toilet notice, portable heater, entry book, paper bag.

Exits: bar · outside · cloakroom · washroom.
You wait 11 minutes. The city keeps its own appointments.
You leave black envelope here.
You close side door.

passages.text:
The taxi idles outside Velvet. Your phone holds an unsigned invitation. A black envelope lies beside you on the seat. Beyond the window, a narrow awning shelters the side entrance.

You can see black envelope, back seat, taxi window, taxi meter, cab receipt, ceiling light.

Exits: outside.
You take black envelope.

Rain writes over the taxi's tyre marks. Velvet's side entrance glows beneath a narrow awning. The loading bay runs behind the building; a soup kiosk stays lit across the road.

You can see side door, narrow awning, club window, velvet sign, street bin, brick wall.

Exits: inside · loading bay · kiosk · home · front door.

Warm air. Wet wool. A corridor the colour of dried wine. A notice points left to the working toilets. The bar is ahead; a cloakroom opens on the right.

Here: Inez Vale.

You can see dry ledge, wooden bench, toilet notice, portable heater, entry book, paper bag.

Exits: bar · outside · cloakroom · washroom.
You wait 24 minutes. The city keeps its own appointments.
Inez leaves to get on with the night.
You leave black envelope here.

passages.text:
The taxi idles outside Velvet. Your phone holds an unsigned invitation. A black envelope lies beside you on the seat. Beyond the window, a narrow awning shelters the side entrance.

You can see black envelope, back seat, taxi window, taxi meter, cab receipt, ceiling light.

Exits: outside.
You take black envelope.

Rain writes over the taxi's tyre marks. Velvet's side entrance glows beneath a narrow awning. The loading bay runs behind the building; a soup kiosk stays lit across the road.

You can see side door, narrow awning, club window, velvet sign, street bin, brick wall.

Exits: inside · loading bay · kiosk · home · front door.

Warm air. Wet wool. A corridor the colour of dried wine. A notice points left to the working toilets. The bar is ahead; a cloakroom opens on the right.

Here: Inez Vale.

You can see dry ledge, wooden bench, toilet notice, portable heater, entry book, paper bag.

Exits: bar · outside · cloakroom · washroom.
You wait 24 minutes. The city keeps its own appointments.
Inez leaves to get on with the night.
You put black envelope on dry ledge.

passages.text:
The taxi idles outside Velvet. Your phone holds an unsigned invitation. A black envelope lies beside you on the seat. Beyond the window, a narrow awning shelters the side entrance.

You can see black envelope, back seat, taxi window, taxi meter, cab receipt, ceiling light.

Exits: outside.
You take black envelope.

Rain writes over the taxi's tyre marks. Velvet's side entrance glows beneath a narrow awning. The loading bay runs behind the building; a soup kiosk stays lit across the road.

You can see side door, narrow awning, club window, velvet sign, street bin, brick wall.

Exits: inside · loading bay · kiosk · home · front door.

Warm air. Wet wool. A corridor the colour of dried wine. A notice points left to the working toilets. The bar is ahead; a cloakroom opens on the right.

Here: Inez Vale.

You can see dry ledge, wooden bench, toilet notice, portable heater, entry book, paper bag.

Exits: bar · outside · cloakroom · washroom.
You wait 24 minutes. The city keeps its own appointments.
Inez leaves to get on with the night.
You put black envelope on dry ledge.
You close side door.
